meta.law_bounds_note: bounds apply to the scaled fit on y/std(y_train); legacy (b0,b1,b2,A) box maps exactly onto this (a0,a1,a2) box
meta.gp: ConstantKernel(1,(1e-3,1e3)) * Matern(ls=[1]*4, nu=2.5, (1e-2,1e3)) + WhiteKernel(1e-3,(1e-6,1e1)), normalize_y, n_restarts 0, alpha 1e-10, X standardized in fold
meta.stability_rule: PhysGP if inner-fold f0 spread (max - min) < 2.0 Hz and sign(a2) constant over inner folds, else plain GP
meta.inner_cv_rule: PhysGP if inner leave-one-level-out pooled R2 (global denominator over outer training rows) of PhysGP exceeds that of plain GP, else plain GP (ties -> plain GP)
meta.predictions_csv_intervals: lower/upper = y_pred -/+ 1.96 sd, the Gaussian 95% posterior interval of the GP (not jackknife+); empty for law-alone and rule rows

results/a2_predictions.csv: out-of-fold predictions of gp, physgp, law, gp_linF, physgp_offset, rule_inner_cv, rule_stability; split schemes ending in _excl_dup are the n = 72 sensitivity runs

gp_optimizer_sensitivity_rms.method: plain GP LOO on V_rms refit after adding N(0, sd^2) noise with sd equal to the tight-tolerance law-mean difference, seed 0

equivalence.explanation: Both forms reach the same least-squares minimum: at tolerance 1e-15 the law means agree to the reported law_mean_max_abs_diff_tight_tol_V and the SSE difference is at rounding level. At the legacy curve_fit default tolerance (1e-8) both forms stop early at slightly different points; this, not a different optimum, is the source of differences of order 1e-6 V against the legacy JSON, and the legacy six-parameter code rerun at its own tolerance also differs from its stored JSON by a similar amount. The remaining difference between the two PhysGP forms at tight tolerance (about 1e-6 V) comes from the GP hyperparameter optimizer (L-BFGS-B at scikit-learn default tolerances), which moves plain-GP LOO predictions by an amount of the same order when the target is perturbed at the size of the law-mean difference (gp_optimizer_sensitivity_rms). For V_pp and |V|_max the law means also agree to about 1e-8 V, yet single LOO folds differ by up to 0.38 V (V_pp, forms at tolerance 1e-15) and 0.105 V (|V|_max, five-parameter tight versus six-parameter legacy tolerance). There the GP hyperparameter optimizer, started once (n_restarts_optimizer = 0), lands in different local optima of the marginal likelihood for residuals that are equal to about 1e-8 V; the log marginal likelihoods at the worst fold are recorded. restart_check repeats the LOO with four extra optimizer starts.
